searchText: Hi all. Creating this thread to discuss <@881905303011086387>'s PR: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/5152 Etan does this affect the issue we were chatting about with `ExecutionPayloadHeader`? Regardless, if this makes it easier for light clients, this PR seems like a reasonable ask to me. I'd like to hear what <@755590043632140352> thinks too. no, latest_execution_block_payload -> latest_block_hash is orthogonal. that one just increases the cost for obtaining basic metadata like block number or gas usage, as one now has to go via JSON-RPC (often another paid API call) or extra latency in a portal style world. but it is not preventing designs, just making the happy case more expensive. this one is solely about retaining the ability to sync an EL with newPayload + fcU using just a single gossip topic for each of the purposes newPayload from envelopes topic, and fcU from light client topic Got it. That makes sense. originally, parent_beacon_block_root was in the payload. we removed it because the surrounding beaconblock already contains it, and we didn't want to duplicate it but now the payload was moved, so we just have to move the parent_beacon_block_root to the new surrounding container (i.e., the envelope, now) engine_newPayload needs 4 things: the payload itself, the blob versioned hashes / kzg commitments (derivable from payload.transactions), the requests (part of the envelope), and the parent beacon block root (currently unavailable when just following envelopes gossip) <@881905303011086387> this is really about getting a single message instead of waiting for two and verifying. Correct? I believe CL light clients were always a mistake, but having said so, this is really cheap and I see no reason not to do it.
